summary.text: Laurel Libby is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 90, Androscoggin County, representing Auburn and Minot.
The page lists committee service on Labor.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Laurel Libby's education as Education Bachelor of Science, Roberts Wesleyan College (Degree Nursing, 2003).
Laurel Libby lives in Auburn and has served 3 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Family details on the page: spouse John, 5 children, 1 grandchild.
